title: room divider
text: room divider. Ok... it's a loose weave fiber... looks nice.. the weave is looser than it looks in the picture.  They come assembled - minus the the shelves you just slide right in.  Kinda helps to stable the screen - so that's cool.  It's fairly lightweight.  It's gonna work - I do wish the weave was not so loose (meaning you can see through it sort of ) - but short of that - I'm happy with it. I purchased the dark brown.  It is about 6 ft tall.  and about that long or so.
